brand.$description: Tier 2 brand identity — Sofia (Topaze AIR / AiCalendar). ADDITIVE over Corilus. Electric Blue #3858C7 primary carrying white text at AA (~6.2:1); Turquoise accent; white inverted secondary. Everything not listed inherits Corilus.

primary.$description: Sofia Electric Blue 50 #3858C7 — exact brand colour (off-ramp). Action accent + active states.

primary-deep.$description: Solid action fill (Electric Blue 45); carries WHITE text at AA (~6.2:1).

primary-bright.$description: Electric Blue 70 — accent/icon on dark surfaces.

secondary.$description: White — Sofia inverts to white on dark / ambient surfaces.

logo.$description: Sofia has no verbatim SVG logo asset. It resolves to the recoloured brain-mark, which READS these vars live as its gradient source.

accent.$description: Sofia inverted-surface accent — Topaze Turquoise (#28D6D7). Reserved to inverted blocks + ambient.

tint.$description: Selected-state overlay at the Electric Blue hue (267.4). Concrete OKLCH-with-alpha, shared tint weight (L/C 0.5792/0.1048); composites over any surface. Hex fallback #5f77b8.
